title: Children of a depth-one gate are literals
statement: Let $C$ be the Boolean circuit consisting of a single gate (an AND gate or an OR gate, according to a flag $\mathit{isAnd}$) applied to a list $cs$ of child circuits, so that the depth of $C$ equals $1$ plus the maximum depth among the circuits in $cs$. If the depth of $C$ is at most $1$, then every child circuit $c \in cs$ has depth $0$; that is, each child is a literal.
hypotheses_covered: circuit is a single AND/OR node applied to children cs
the node's depth is at most 1
replaced:
If a node $\mathrm{Circuit.node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has depth at most $1$, then every
child $c \in cs$ has depth $0$.
